title: Optionals and Error Handling
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of optionals and error handling in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 7: Optionals and Error Handling. Lessons in order: Introduction to Optionals; Unwrapping Optionals; Optional Binding with guard let; Optional Chaining; Nil-Coalescing and Optional Transformation; Implicitly Unwrapped Optionals; Introduction to Error Handling; Handling Errors with do-catch; try , try? , and try!; Error Handling Design.
